purpose: Teach: 途切れ/有り難い/延長線/掌/讃える/気がつけ/肴/本郷

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、昨日、本気で、絶対、お話が、絶対、途切れた、絶対、ところから、絶対、続きを、絶対、聞きたいよ
lines.en: Riku — I seriously need to hear the rest of that story from where it cut off yesterday.
lines.style: Urgent, direct opening. Leaning forward energy. Quick pace, no breath pauses. Absolute focus on him — the kind of attention that makes someone feel seen.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お前の応援、本気で、絶対、俺、絶対、有り難い、絶対、と、絶対、思ってるぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. I'm really grateful for how much you believe in me, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Slight catch under the words — emotion held steady. Eyes down briefly, then up. Warm but grounded, not performative.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日の練習、本気で、絶対、いつもの、絶対、延長線、絶対、上だよね、リク
lines.en: Today's practice — you were way beyond your usual level, Riku.
lines.style: Noticing tone. Slower cadence, like she's watching something crystallize. Genuine observation, not flattery. Slight wonder underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、掌、絶対、ペンだこ、絶対、あるよな、桜
lines.en: Your hands — you've got calluses from all that writing practice, don't you.
lines.style: Gentle pointing-out. Eyes on his hands, not his face. Small smile in the voice. Affectionate noticing — the detail matters to her because it's him.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、努力、絶対、私、絶対、讃える、絶対、よ、リク
lines.en: I really respect the effort you've been putting in, Riku.
lines.style: Direct and sincere. No softening. Steady eye-level tone. The kind of praise that lands because it's specific and unadorned.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 気がつけば、本気で、絶対、もう、絶対、卒業、絶対、近いんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Before you know it, graduation's going to be here, Sakura.
lines.style: Wistful drop at the end. Slower opening, like he's just noticed the distance closing. Weight under the words — not sad, but aware.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お酒の肴、絶対、家で、絶対、用意してたよ、リク
lines.en: Your grandfather even had sake snacks ready at home for this.
lines.style: Soft shift in focus. Noticing the care in the background. Quieter note — recognizing something generous and unhurried.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行、本気で、絶対、本郷の、絶対、東大、絶対、見学、絶対、入ってるぜ、桜
lines.en: The school trip has a visit to Tokyo University built right into it, Sakura.
lines.style: Animated energy returning. Brighter attack. The kind of detail that matters — he's been thinking about this. Small brightness at the end, like a door opening.
